build_bindings_cc: build C++ WASM bindings for MuJoCo by running update.py with a template and output path
create_binding_builder: create a BindingBuilder instance from a C++ template file for WASM code generation
run_set_enums: run set_enums to generate and inject enum bindings into the C++ template
run_set_structs: run set_structs to generate and inject struct bindings into the C++ template
run_set_functions: run set_functions to generate and inject function wrappers into the C++ template
